question: What is the main purpose of a long term strategy for a wastewater collection utility?
correctAnswer: To align renewal, capacity, and levels of service with expected growth over many years
explanation: A long term strategy looks many years ahead so that renewal, capacity, and service commitments stay matched to growth and asset condition.
options: To schedule only the next month of cleaning work
To align renewal, capacity, and levels of service with expected growth over many years
To set individual operator shift rotations
To choose the brand of jetting equipment to buy
optionA: To schedule only the next month of cleaning work
optionB: To align renewal, capacity, and levels of service with expected growth over many years
optionC: To set individual operator shift rotations
optionD: To choose the brand of jetting equipment to buy
